subject: Paired-end read counting using featureCounts and read2pos 5/3

messages.author: 032338dabe43cf2d
messages.subject: Paired-end read counting using featureCounts and read2pos 5/3
parts:
Hello,

This may be a silly question, but how does featureCounts perform read assignment of fragments (i.e. paired-end reads) when combined with --read2pos 5/3? 

For example, if i set --read2pos 3, does it determine the 3'-most base position for mates 1 and 2 by looking up their POS and CIGAR fields?

Thanks

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Paired-end read counting using featureCounts and read2pos 5/3
parts:
The '--read2pos' parameter is applied to each individual read and featureCounts does use POS and CIGAR fields to reduce reads to their 3' or 5' end base.

Wei
